description: Find the Arkansas SENTENCING SERIOUSNESS LEVEL (1-10) of a felony offense by statute citation or offense name, from the Arkansas Sentencing Commission's offense seriousness ranking table. Answers "what seriousness level is aggravated robbery in Arkansas", "level of 5-12-103", "Arkansas sentencing ranking for Murder 1st degree". Each match returns the statute, felony class, offense name, ranking level, percent of sentence to serve, statutory designations (A 70% offense, B possible 70% offense, C serious violent felony, D violent felony, E 100% felon in possession), and start/end dates when the ranking or offense changed. Pass the level to ar_sentencing_grid for the presumptive range. Matches by statute prefix ("5-10-102") or by every word of the name. Keyless.

query.description: Statute citation ("5-12-103") or offense name words ("aggravated robbery").
